coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Pier 70 Parcel E1
record.summary: Residential parcel on Maryland Street north of Building 21, mostly 90 ft with a 65 ft north leg under the D4D, assigned to Phase 2C in the Port's proposed 2026 phasing plan. Under the 2017 DDA the lease of historic Building 21 is triggered within a year after completion of the building on E1.

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- no vertical construction is reported on this block (Port Item 11A, Aug 7, 2026: construction of Phase 1 vertical projects and parks has not moved forward, and the developer has not exercised an option on any Phase 1 option parcel). It has not been matched to a specific Assessor lot: DataSF's Assessor layer shows the 28-acre site re-mapped into many active P70-MU lots (blocks 4052 and 4110-4117, mostly added 2019-02-07, most with no street address) and Port Item 12B (Feb 2020) gives Parcel E2 as Block 4116 Lot 008, so which lot, if any, corresponds to this block has not been checked against the recorded final map. Redone 2026-09-14 with a corrected, shear-free transform -- treat vertex positions as accurate to roughly 5-15m, not survey-grade. NOTE: this polygon is NOT clipped against real streets or existing buildings -- unlike Potrero's approximate blocks, several of Pier 70's D4D blocks are sited on existing industrial buildings that will be demolished, so overlap with a currently-real building is often expected, not an error; a boundary that appears to touch or slightly cross a street centerline reflects this transform's 1-8m residual error, not a deliberate encroachment. Street-facing edge re-clipped 2026-09-17 against official curb-referenced street data.
notes.digitized_from: Pier 70 Design for Development, Figure 6.4.2 - Maximum Building Height (p.155).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: Not matched to a specific Assessor lot. DataSF's Assessor layer shows the Pier 70 28-acre site re-mapped into many active P70-MU lots in blocks 4052 and 4110-4117 (mostly added 2019-02-07), so the earlier statement that it has not been subdivided is withdrawn; which lot corresponds to this block has not been checked against the recorded final map, so this record uses hand-traced approximate geometry instead.
notes.regulatory_context: Residential, mostly 90 ft max with a smaller 65 ft strip along its north leg per Figure 6.4.2. No construction-start source found. Geometry here is a simplified bounding shape -- the real parcel has an irregular footprint around the historic Building 21 (mapped separately in this project) immediately to its southeast.

open_questions: No construction start, building permit or vertical DDA for this parcel was found in any Port Commission document through the Port's Item 11A staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026, for the Aug 11, 2026 meeting), which says the developer 'has not exercised an option of any Phase 1 option parcels'.

Per-parcel gross square footage and unit counts are not published in the D4D (which sets height, stories and land-use scenarios, not parcel programs); the SUD's per-parcel programs would be in the SUD ordinance (Planning Code Sec. 249.79) or the Phase Submittal, neither of which was retrieved.

The SF YIMBY summary describing E-1A/E-1B as ~120,000 gsf of retail and arts space conflicts with the D4D's residential designation for E1; the underlying filing was not retrieved, so this is left as reported.

The notes on this record's mapped shape say E1's real footprint is irregular around Building 21; the D4D figure shows E1 as two pieces (a 90-ft block and a 65-ft north leg) either side of Building 21's setback.
